title: Best Dumbbells for Home Workouts in India (2026)
summary: Three dumbbell picks for home workouts in India: a light fixed pair, a 10 kg hex and a plate kit. Not hand-tested; based on shop pages.
description: A plain buying guide to home dumbbells in India: a fixed pair, a hex dumbbell and a plate kit from Decathlon. Based on shop pages, not hand-tested.
lead: Which dumbbells should you buy for working out at home? This guide looks at three options sold in India. One is a light fixed pair for first-timers. One is a single 10 kg hex dumbbell for a later step. One is a plate kit that grows with you. We have not hand-tested any of them. We read shop pages and maker pages, and we say clearly what we could not confirm.

picks.name: Domyos Fitness Dumbbells Twin-Pack, 3 kg, grey
picks.label: For first-timers
cells: About 4.8 of 5 from a couple of thousand buyers
picks.verdict: A simple light pair with no setup. A easy place to start for arm and shoulder work.
paragraphs: This is a fixed-weight pair from Domyos, Decathlon's own brand. The Decathlon India page calls it a 3 kg twin-pack. It says the iron is partly recycled. Fixed means the weight cannot be changed. You pick them up and use them, with no collars to tighten. The page shows a 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge. Decathlon sells it directly.

Some things could not be confirmed. The page title says 3 kg but does not say if that is per dumbbell or for the pair. The page address mentions a hex shape and a soft PVC touch. The page text does not say what the coating is or what shape the heads have. No size or handle details are listed, and stock was not shown. The same line also appears in a 2 kg navy version. The review text did not load, so we could not read what buyers praise or complain about.
good: Light fixed weights suit people who are just starting out.
Sold by Decathlon itself, with a 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge on the page.
The shop page shows about 4.8 out of 5 from a couple of thousand buyers.
not_good: The coating is not confirmed as rubber. The page address hints at soft PVC, so it may not be the rubber-coated set you picture.
You get one weight per pair, so you must buy another pair to move up.
The page does not say if 3 kg is per dumbbell or for the pair.

picks.name: Corength 10 kg Hexagonal Dumbbell, black
picks.label: For a later step up
cells: About 4.8 of 5 from a few hundred buyers
picks.verdict: A heavier hex dumbbell for when a light pair feels too easy. Best added after you have a lighter pair.
paragraphs: This is a 10 kg hexagonal dumbbell from Corength, another Decathlon brand. A hex head has six flat sides, a shape made to stop the dumbbell rolling away. The Decathlon India page title is singular. You likely need to buy two for a pair, but the page does not say this outright. It shows a 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge.

Be careful with the materials. The India page text lists none. Its web address says rubber and recycled cast iron with an ergonomic grip. Decathlon Canada's page for the same size lists different details, so we treat the materials as unconfirmed for India. Handle size, warranty beyond 2 years, stock and review text were also not available.
good: The hex shape is made so the dumbbell does not roll.
The shop page shows about 4.8 out of 5 from a few hundred buyers.
Decathlon India also lists a 12.5 kg hex dumbbell with a similar page title, so you may be able to go heavier later.
not_good: 10 kg may feel heavy as a first weight. It suits a second step better.
It is likely sold one at a time, so a pair means buying two.
The India page gives no size or material text, and the India address and the Canada page do not match.

picks.name: Domyos Versatile Weight Training Kit 50 kg with Plates, Barbell and Dumbbell Bars
picks.label: For one kit that grows with you
cells: About 4.8 of 5 from a few hundred buyers
picks.verdict: One kit that covers light to heavier loads, if you do not mind swapping discs.
paragraphs: This is a plate-loaded kit. You get two short dumbbell bars, one long barbell bar and discs that slide on and off. Decathlon's Malta page for the same kit lists 38 kg of discs, two 2 kg dumbbell bars (35 cm long), a 7.8 kg barbell bar and three pairs of collars. The maker says the weights adjust in 1 kg steps and calls it a set for beginners. The 50 kg is the total for the whole kit, so each dumbbell can hold less than that.

The Decathlon India page lists only the title, a 2 year warranty badge, a 30 day replacement badge and reviews. The details above come from the Malta page. We could not confirm that the India kit has the same contents. Decathlon India also shows a 50 kg kit under the Corength name with a different rating, and we could not confirm if it is the same product. Bar material, grip texture and stock were not listed. The review text did not load.
good: One kit covers dumbbells and a barbell, so it can grow with you.
The maker says the weights adjust in 1 kg steps.
The India page shows about 4.8 out of 5 from a few hundred buyers, and a 2 year warranty badge.
not_good: Changing discs and collars is slower than picking up a fixed dumbbell.
The maker says to wipe the bare iron with a damp cloth and keep it dry, never in a basement or outdoors. It needs more care than coated weights.
The dumbbell bars are short at 35 cm (Malta page). The maker suggests a cage with safety rests or a spotter for the long barbell.

choose.heading: Start light and go up in small steps
choose.text: Pick a weight you can lift with control. Start light and move up slowly. This is general advice, not medical advice. If you are unsure, ask a qualified trainer or doctor.

choose.heading: Plan for more than one weight
choose.text: Most people end up wanting at least two weights. A lighter one suits smaller muscles, and a heavier one suits larger muscles.

choose.heading: Fixed or adjustable
choose.text: Fixed dumbbells need no setup, but you buy each weight separately. Plate-loaded kits cover a range in one box, but changing the weight takes longer. The maker of the Decathlon kit says its weights adjust in 1 kg steps.

choose.heading: Check one dumbbell or a pair
choose.text: Read the title and the pack contents. Check if the weight shown is per dumbbell or the total. Some Decathlon India pages do not spell this out, so look closely before you order.

choose.heading: Look at the shape and coating
choose.text: A hex head is made to stop a dumbbell rolling. Plate kits use bare cast iron, so keep them dry and wipe them with a damp cloth, as the maker says. Check the page for what the coating really is.

choose.heading: Read the exact product page
choose.text: Listings can disagree. The 50 kg kit appears under two brands with different ratings, and a page address can say something different from the page text. Warranty and return terms also differ by country, so check the India page.

faq.q: How heavy should my first dumbbells be?
faq.a: Pick a weight you can lift with control and move up slowly. Larger muscles usually handle more weight than smaller ones. This is general advice, not medical advice, so ask a qualified trainer if you are unsure.

faq.q: Should I buy fixed or adjustable dumbbells?
faq.a: Fixed ones are quick and need no setup, but you buy each weight separately. A plate kit gives a range in one box, but changing discs is slower.

faq.q: Is the 10 kg Corength listing one dumbbell or two?
faq.a: The title is singular, so it is likely one dumbbell and you would buy two for a pair. The page does not say this outright, so check before you order.

faq.q: Do these come with a warranty?
faq.a: The Decathlon India pages show a 2 year warranty badge and a 30 day replacement badge. The terms sit behind a link we did not read, so check the policy on the page.
